high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "finforall." The post is part of the Explore section, as indicated by the title at the top. The post includes a statement about the financial implications of war costs, specifically referencing Afghanistan. The text reads: "And then comes the interest on the costs. According to quotes in the Forbes, the interest paid on the war in Afghanistan could reach costs of up to $6.5 trillion till 2050. That's more than twice the GDP of India!"
